svg.title: Snapshot time and averaging interval
svg.desc: Aligned schematic timeline. A snapshot is at 06:00. An ocean mean covers 05:00 to 06:00 and carries the native label 05:30. Exact common-label matching does not match these records. The explicitly selected preceding-hour association can pair the interval with its end-time snapshot, without reconstructing an instantaneous ocean field.

g.text: What time does each value represent?
common: labels differ — no pair here
Schematic · association does not turn the mean into a snapshot
